payload.core_mechanism_summary: Maintain count c of nodes with no friends of higher index (l[i]==0) using sorted edge endpoints; c is the answer after killing process.
payload.rationale: Solution exploits invariant that survivors are exactly nodes with no larger-index friends. Sorting edge endpoints reveals which node increments its count, enabling O(1) updates per query. This aligns with greedy_sorting_order due to reliance on index ordering.
